issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md declares getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type void, but the textual instructions state the method should return a String (format: "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)"). The solution implementation also returns a String. This inconsistency in the problem statement (UML vs. text) can confuse students about the expected return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md so getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() is declared to return String (getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String) to match the textual description and the solution. Optionally, make the expected signature explicit in the template TODO comments to avoid ambiguity.
